rag.text:
Test: TC-1653 — Feature area - Marker - LiveSync for markers on Calendar
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-8 Feature area - Marker
Labels: teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to app's configuration > General > Live-sync tab

Turn on Enable LiveSync on markers and click Save
   Expected: Configuration is saved.
2. Navigate to Calendar module of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-1653 Feature area - Marker - LiveSync for markers on Calendar
   Expected: Calendar module is displayed
3. Open the same page in another window

Position the windows so that they are open side by side
   Expected: Calendar is opened in two different windows, side by side.
4. Refresh a both of the pages with Calendar modules.
   Expected: The pages are refreshed
5. Create a marker in the first window
   Data: markerName: Test LiveSync
markerDate: 24/Mar/21
   Expected: Marker is displayed in the first window.

After a few seconds, marker appears in the second window.
6. Change marker's color and date in the first window
   Data: markerDate: 25/Mar/21
markerColour: light_brown
   Expected: Marker is changed in the first window.

After a few seconds, marker is changed in the second window.
7. Delete the marker in the first window
   Expected: Marker is deleted in the first window.

After a few seconds, marker is deleted in the second window.
8. Create a marker in the first window

Quickly create a marker with the same date in the second window
   Data: markerName: LiveSync
markerDate: 26/Mar/21
   Expected: The first created marker is on top of the other one in both windows.
9. Edit a marker in the first window

Quickly edit the same marker in the second window
   Data: markerDate: 27/Mar/21
markerColour: brown
   Expected: Changes from the second edit are applied in both windows.
10. Open marker's edit modal in the first window

Delete the same marker in the second window

Update or delete the marker in the first window
   Data: markerName: LiveSync
   Expected: Information about non-existent marker appears in the first window.

No errors occur.
